meta.title: feat: implement comprehensive species tracking system with seasonal/yearly detection badges
meta.body_summary: Add a comprehensive species tracking system with lifetime, yearly, and seasonal detection badges, database indexing, caching, and frontend dashboard optimizations.

perf_labels.notes: Claude Code generated a large feature PR with species tracking, caching, and batch lookups; merged by author after extensive coderabbitai bot reviews with narrative-only performance claims.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 8353 changed lines across 34 files, this is a large feature addition by absolute volume. Despite the size, it was self-merged by the maintainer after only non-blocking automated bot reviews, consistent with a repository where AI-generated large features are accepted without formal human approval.

review_details.concern_detail: coderabbitai bot posted multiple rounds of suggestions covering test parallelization, proper error handling (use require), variable naming, and cache optimization, but no human maintainer raised blocking concerns.
review_details.performance_claim: Improved performance via caching, composite database indexes, batch species status lookups, and dashboard rendering optimizations.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Claude Code managed a large cross-stack feature with extensive tests and integrated iterative feedback from automated review without blocking from human reviewers; merge was swift without formal human approval, indicating a high trust in AI-generated contributions.

detection_detail.code_reading: coderabbitai bot performed static analysis and suggested improvements on test practices, error handling, and caching; no human reviewed performance claims.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or profiling data in PR body; performance claims are narrative only about caching and indexing benefits.

core_change_summary.description: Introduced NewSpeciesTracker with configurable lifetime/yearly/seasonal windows; added GetSpeciesFirstDetectionInPeriod database method; added caching layer for daily summary and batch species status lookups; added frontend animated biodiversity badges; added composite index on species detection date.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Extensive test files and observability via event bus and logging accompany the core feature implementation.
change_trajectory: Initial commit adds NewSpeciesTracker core and basic dashboard integration.
Multiple commits add comprehensive unit, concurrent, and integration tests.
Integration with detection event bus and notification consumer.
Caching layer for daily summary and batch species status lookups added.
Frontend dashboard optimizations with static metadata, memoized URL builders, and animated icons.
Iterative commits address coderabbitai bot feedback: test parallelization, error handling, and lint fixes.
Final merge after ~2.5 hours with 5 non-blocking bot reviews.

review_signals.summary: Suggested adding t.Parallel() to various test functions for faster execution.
review_signals.action_taken: Some t.Parallel() calls added in subsequent commits.

review_signals.summary: Recommended using require.NoError instead of assert.NoError for critical initializations, and handling InitFromDatabase errors.
Warning about variable shadowing imported package 'events' and suggested renaming local variable.
review_signals.action_taken: Fixed in commit 63e1bbb by renaming to eventsCopy.

review_signals.summary: Provided initial review with 38 actionable comments covering test structure, error handling, and documentation.
review_signals.action_taken: Multiple follow-up commits addressed many suggestions.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened by tphakala with large feature implementation by Claude Code.
coderabbitai bot provided initial review with 38 actionable comments within ~10 minutes.
Series of commits addressed some bot feedback (test restructure, mock improvements, test parallelization).
Additional bot reviews suggested further test improvements and code cleanup.
Maintainer pushed final fix commits (linter warnings, error handling) and self-merged without formal human approval.
